title: Free trial ending soon
description: Warn users on WhatsApp that their free trial ends in a few days, with a link to pick a plan. Marketing template for SaaS conversion.
notes: Treat as marketing since it nudges a purchase. State the exact end date and what the user will lose.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your free trial of Lumen ends on *{{end_date}}*. Choose a plan to keep your {{projects}} projects and data, or reply if you need more time.
